messages:
Maya (frontend): Heads-up — planning a blue/green slot swap for Console at 21:00 UTC. Target: v3.12.2 -> slot B. Need a smoke owner and rollback readiness. I will kick off invalidation after the swap.

Jonah: I can own smoke checks. I'll be on-call 20:50-22:10 UTC. :thumbsup:

Samir: Quick Q — are we doing a full distribution invalidation or per-path? prefer per-path to avoid edge thrash.

Maya (frontend): Per-path invalidation: /static/console/* + manifest entries only. Flow: swap slots, invalidate manifest key first, then shallow invalidation for changed bundles if hashes differ.

Fae: I'll run the smoke checklist once swap is complete. Checklist highlights: login, open workspace heavy view, navigate to Settings, repo list pagination, and trigger one API-heavy route. Ping me when swap completed. :eyes: 

Maya (frontend): Rollback plan: swap slots back + re-invalidate manifest. No DB changes. ui_v3 feature flag stays off during rollout. We'll start with 2% canary for 5m, then full swap if green.

Samir: CloudFront CLI snippet for per-path invalidation in case it's helpful:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABCDEF --paths "/static/console/*" \n```

Maya (frontend): Deploy bot scheduled the job: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1951234567 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window 21:00 UTC — initiated by Maya (frontend).

Jonah: When I swap I'll post quick smoke results: HTTP 200 for /console, bundle checksum matches, login succeeds, key routes respond under 300ms. If we see repeat 5xx or critical UX break, we revert.

Fae: Also check edge caching headers on bundles (Cache-Control, s-maxage). I'll capture resp headers and attach a short curl snippet for verification.

Maya (frontend): Thanks — I'll post final go/no-go at 20:55 and drop a link to the release notes: https://docs.redwood/rel/v3.12.2

Jonah: Acked. See you at 21:00. :white_check_mark:
